summary: Round 1 F1 and F2 are fixed in the delivered w04 and w07 videos. Every figure box now has the Figure aspect, so the drawn body fills its box. Every box of every w04 and w07 line lies inside the frame or the phone scene band, with no overlap. The exit tail is gone, so the actors of two shots never draw together. The band-relative P2-F6 floor is a justified re-anchor, not a vacuous weakening. Week 1 and the scene-video weeks are unaffected. No blocker; three nonblocking items.
nonblocking_findings: N1 [Minor] review-a: plan.md:91 moves Daniel's look check out of the done-when, to 'its result is recorded in closeout'. Phase 3 (plan.md, 'Task: tech-debt and lessons-learned.') holds no task that records that look check. The sub-bullets at plan.md:94-95 still say 'Task stays open until ... the look check approves' while the task is [x]. Route to the orchestrator: add the look-check record to the closeout, or note it under tech debt.

N2 [Nit] review-a: Test meaning gaps in tests/phase2-boxes.test.mjs. P2-F8 (lines 137-168) mirrors the 240/340 aspect as a literal and does not read Figure.tsx, so a Figure aspect change passes. Its portrait in-frame check uses the 1920 composition height, not the 607.5 px scene band, where overflow hidden clips (SongPortrait.tsx:47). P2-F9 (lines 170-194) is a source-text regex on 'shot.exit' and 'EXIT_SECONDS'; a literal 0.3 tail passes it, and its tiling part tests timeline.ts, which this round did not change. timeline.ts:52 still sets shot.exit, which no renderer reads now. Tech debt.

N3 [Nit] review-a: Look item for Daniel, not a contract defect. The classroom slots moved right with the wider figure box (actorBoxes.ts:71-74). In w04 the classroom Grandpa (x 561-734) and Tom (x 1180-1354), and the single-actor Lily (x 573-723), stand on the rug fringe; the phone Grandma and Grandpa also stand on the rug edge. The tested rug centre (x 760-1160) stays free, and the d398c235 boxes also touched the fringe. Record for the look check.

F1 fixed (code): actorBoxes.ts:71 and 83-85 set the figure box width to height*240/340, which is the Figure svg width (Figure.tsx:243-246, viewBox -20 -30 240 340). Actors.tsx:65-68 divides the box by boxScale and passes the scene height to Figure, so the svg width in frame px equals box.width. The NEUTRAL pose (Figure.tsx:16-22, hands x 46-154, head x 54-146) is centred at viewBox x 100, the svg half width, so the body centre is the box centre.

F1 fixed (numbers): a node script over public/l2/w04 and w07 spec.json with actorBoxes and shots() prints every shot and both cuts with no BAD line: every box inside 1920x1080 (classroom) or 1080x607.5 (phone band), the figure aspect exact, and no box overlap. w04 portrait line 2 Dad box is [934.9,250,141.2,200], right edge 1076 < 1080 (green-p2-r7-01f45859.txt:24 agrees).

F1 fixed (frames): frames-p2r7-w04-phone-10.jpg shows Dad inside the frame at the right. Frames I extracted from the delivered videos show all six actors of the five-member line inside the frame in both cuts (w04 video 19 s and 38.2 s), Tom on line 6 and Grandma on line 9 inside the phone frame (31 s, 47 s), and May visible in both w07 cuts (8 s).

F2 fixed: Song.tsx:105-108 sets durationInFrames to f(shot.end)-f(shot.start), and shots() tiles (shot.end equals next.start), so the frame windows are contiguous. EXIT_SECONDS is removed with no other importer (grep). Frames at shot changes show only the new shot: w04 13.48 s (one Lily, no Dad), w04 24.12 s both cuts (Tom and Lily only, after the six-actor shot), w07 25.72 s classroom (Ben, ToyBox, Doll; no May).
Delivered media: sha256 of w04 and w07 song.mp4 and song-phone.mp4 equal the Green record in green-p2-r7-01f45859.txt:51,53,104,106.

P2-F6 floor not vacuous: the old phone floor (0.22 of 1920 = 422 px) with the P2-F8 aspect needs 298 px per figure, and the five-member line needs five figures, 1490 px > 1080, so both rules could not hold. The new floor (133-273 px of the 607.5 px band) still fails a row below 133 px. The 200 px phone row is 0.329 of the scene band; the classroom row is 246/1080 = 0.228 of the same scene, so phone figures are relatively larger than classroom figures.

P2-F8 and P2-F9 failed first: red-p2-r8-d398c235.log records exit 1 with P2-F8 'w04 line 1 classroom Mom full figure extent must lie inside its box' and P2-F9 'exit tail in Song true, slide-out in Actors false'. The math agrees: the old classroom box was 150 px wide for a 211.8 px svg.

Week 1 media sha256 4c88951f... and 74ccefed... are unchanged (sha256sum at this HEAD). Bubbles: SoundCard order after the scene layer is unchanged in this diff. Lyric (y 872) and inset (x 1602) stay clear: classroom feet at 800 and rightmost box edge 1527; phone boxes end at y 450 inside the 607.5 band.

Callers: actorBoxes has one renderer caller (Song.tsx:100) and the boxes test; Actors has one caller (Song.tsx:110); SongPortrait reaches it through SceneLayer with the same boxScale. EXIT_SECONDS had no other importer.
